file_insights.changes: Added comprehensive test suite for MetricsCalculator's cadence zone logic

patterns_discovered: Test boundary conditions for cadence zones
Use of helper function (make_reading_with_cadence) to simplify test setup
Testing different scenarios: default zones, zone boundaries, no zones configured
gotchas_discovered: Cadence zones have specific boundary ranges (Z1: 0-75, Z2: 76-85, Z3: 86-95, Z4: 96-105, Z5: 106+)
Metrics calculator must handle cases where cadence zones are not configured
recommendations: Consider adding more edge case tests for extremely low or high cadence values
Potentially add documentation explaining the cadence zone logic
Validate performance impact of cadence zone calculations
